title: Add Tiny Fighter Arena to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]

gist.summary: Added Tiny Fighter Arena to the games catalog. Describe a fighter in one line; AI creates its name, appearance, three moves, quirk, stats, and fighting style, an image model draws its portrait, and the fighter battles in the game.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art fighting arena bordered by little flowers, a newly drawn fighter portrait glows on a retro screen while Polli watches from the referee's corner in a tiny striped visor. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
